decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for Refusal

The proposed first floor side extension, by inclusion of an obtrusive parapet wall and a roof design that would not complement that of the adjacent dwelling or it's end of terrace partner, would result in a design that is unsympathetic with the established built form, which would be detrimental to the appearance of dwelling with respect to the immediate street scene.  The development is therefore considered contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003 and is not compliant with the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.  


INFORMATIVE

The applicant is advised that if amendments were made to the application as recommended in the letter sent to Ashbys, Surrey House, Staines on the 20th August 2004, it would be likely to receive favourable planning consideration.
description: Erection of first floor side extension to dwellinghouse.
